items: Tools (*Tools classes) validate args via ToolPipeline, then call the single IDebugBridge seam; domain failures map to McpException with a stable code via ToolErrors.
Attach binds one ROT display name (!VisualStudio.DTE.x:pid) to one sessionId; steady-state calls re-resolve that binding per call.
cards.title: Handoff 1-2: tool entry and session seam

items: Every COM touch runs on the single dte-dispatcher STA thread; parallel agent calls queue (cap 100) and never touch COM concurrently.
An OLE message filter retries VS-busy rejections briefly; timeouts surface as vs-busy/timeout, never a hang.
cards.title: Handoff 3: STA serialization

items: Live DTE/Debugger RCWs are used inside one dispatcher call only; plain DTO snapshots cross back to the caller.
COM disconnects map per-session to vs-not-running (siblings unaffected); stale work after a caller timeout is skipped, never run late.
cards.title: Handoff 4: VS manipulation and return
